documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Amal Ltd reported a 77% increase in consolidated sales to Rs 240 crore for FY 2025-26, driven primarily by a 164% spike in the price of its main raw material, Sulphur. However, consolidated profit before tax declined by 14% to Rs 28 crore as the company was unable to fully absorb the increased input costs. The company remains debt-free with an increased cash surplus of Rs 38 crore and has recommended a higher dividend of 15%. Amal is currently implementing three capital expenditure projects and evaluating two additional growth opportunities. Amal Ltd reported consolidated revenue of Rs 13,532 lakh and profit before tax of Rs 3,261 lakh for FY 2024-25, supported by higher price realization and capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: Management outlined key objectives to upgrade existing facilities, expand selected products, add new related products, and strengthen the leadership team.
guidance.quote: At this time, we have three key objectives to strengthen our Company further:

demand_outlook.claim: The global and Indian markets for Sulphuric acid are estimated to be growing at approximately 3% per annum.
demand_outlook.quote: Both markets are growing at about 3% per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating two growth projects and will decide on the next steps based on the external business environment.
capex_expansion.quote: Our Company is evaluating two growth projects and will decide the next steps while keeping in focus the external business environment.

capex_expansion.claim: Amal Speciality Chemicals commissioned a new manufacturing plant in 2022-23 with an equivalent capacity of 300 tonnes per day of sulphuric products.
capex_expansion.quote: In 2022–23, ASC commissioned a new manufacturing plant with an equivalent capacity of 300 TPD of sulphuric products, strengthening the presence of our Company in its existing product portfolio.

capex_expansion.claim: The company implemented two projects to enhance steam generation and recovery.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company implemented two projects for better steam generation and recovery.

margins_costs.claim: The price of raw material Sulphur varies from month to month.
margins_costs.quote: The price of the key raw material Sulphur, varies from month to month.

orders_capacity.claim: Higher price realization and capacity utilization were the key factors behind performance improvement.
orders_capacity.quote: The main contributors were higher price realisation and capacity utilisation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company wiped out its remaining carried-forward loss of Rs 14 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: It wiped out its remaining carried forward loss of ` 14 cr which at peak was ` 56 cr.

capital_allocation.claim: The company repaid all borrowings and generated a cash surplus of Rs 22 crore as on March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: It repaid its entire borrowing and generated cash surplus of ` 22 cr (as on March 31, 2025).

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 10% dividend for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board recommended 10% dividend for your consideration, and we trust you will unanimously approve the same.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material Sulphur prices fluctuate on a monthly basis.
risks_headwinds.quote: The price of the key raw material Sulphur, varies from month to month.

management_commitments.claim: The company will seek to create an environment where its key values are consistently practiced, nurtured, and not compromised.
management_commitments.quote: We will seek to create an environment wherein these Values are consistently practised, nurtured and ensured not to be compromised.

management_commitments.claim: Amal will volunteer its resources to contribute towards enhancing the quality of life and standard of living of people, particularly marginalised sections of society.
management_commitments.quote: Amal will volunteer its resources to the extent it can reasonably afford to contribute towards enhancing the quality of life, thereby the standard of living of people, particularly the marginalised sections of society.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to three key objectives: upgrading the manufacturing facility, expanding select existing products/adding new ones, and strengthening the leadership team.
management_commitments.quote: At this time, we have three key objectives to strengthen our Company further:

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
